caption: AI Operation
description: AI-specific attributes for model operations, retrieval systems, and agent activities. e.g. model_name, total_token_counts etc.
name: ai_operation

ai_agent.description: The autonomous AI agent that performed this operation. Carries model identity via ai_agent.ai_model. Populate when the action was performed by an agent rather than a direct model call.

ai_model.description: The AI model involved in this operation. Use for direct model invocations where no autonomous agent is involved. For agent-mediated operations, model identity is carried within ai_agent.ai_model instead.

delegation.description: The delegation under whose authority this AI operation was performed. Links the event to a durable authorization context independent of traces and sessions, enabling correlation of all events executed under the same delegated authority.

containment_reason.caption: Containment Reason
containment_reason.description: The reason enforcement acted on this operation, as reported by the event source — e.g. an operator kill, a guardrail kill, or a crash. Normalized to the caption of containment_reason_id; when the value is 'Other', this carries the event source's native label. Distinct from why a model completion ended (carried in ai_status.stop_reason): this records why enforcement acted, so an operator kill, a guardrail kill, and a crash are distinguishable and time-to-contain is measurable across deployments.

containment_reason_id.caption: Containment Reason ID
containment_reason_id.description: The normalized reason enforcement acted on this operation. Producers map their runtime's native value into this set; when the value is 'Other', set containment_reason to the event source's native label.
